name: 28462-sharegpt-0.6b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, warmup 10% taken out of the bound and applied by completion order, no cooldown, bounded at 1000 requests with a 900 s safety cap, static seed 28462.
workload: a 1000-row ShareGPT V3 conversation replay, materialised in `configs/data/sharegpt-1000-qwen3-0.6b.jsonl` and tokenised with this model's tokenizer: 217393 prompt and 201847 output tokens, prompts mean 217 (p50 85, max 1007), replies mean 202 (p50 148, max 872). Raw completions (`request_format: plain`) at temperature 0.0; each row carries its reply's own length as `output_tokens_count`, so the backend sets `ignore_eos` and generation runs to exactly that many tokens.
purpose: A compact chat assistant handling multi-turn conversations with short prompts and replies for 64 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# The served command is `vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B --enforce-eager`; everything else below is an
# engine default written out so it cannot drift.
model: Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B
enforce-eager: true
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16

# The engine has no static default for these two: it fills them from the device AND from how the
# engine was entered, so unset, the effective value would depend on the caller.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024

# The longest request in configs/data/ is 1007 prompt + 774 output = 1781 tokens.
max-model-len: 4096

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: true
